name: Silk Unsweetened Plain Almond Milk
whyItWorks: Creamy, filtered, blanched almond milk that contains 0g lactose, 0g added sugar, and only 30 calories per cup. Fortified with calcium and vitamin D to protect bone density in IBD without the digestive burden of dairy fat.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve chilled. Pour over Cream of Rice, Cheerios, or blend into gentle fruit smoothies.
